name: noon-mcp
description: noon (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool m

platform_mcp_noon_key_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_noon_key_id.description: key_id from your noon service-account key file (.json), created in the noon Partner portal.

platform_mcp_noon_private_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_PRIVATE_KEY
platform_mcp_noon_private_key.description: private_key (PEM) from the same service-account key file; it signs the RS256 login JWT.

platform_mcp_noon_project_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_PROJECT_CODE
platform_mcp_noon_project_code.description: project_code from the key file, sent as default_project_code at login.

platform_mcp_noon_warehouse_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_WAREHOUSE_CODE
platform_mcp_noon_warehouse_code.description: Integration warehouse code for stock updates and FBPI order listing (see ListWarehouses).

platform_mcp_noon_country_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_COUNTRY_CODE
platform_mcp_noon_country_code.description: Marketplace country code for pricing (e.g. ae, sa, eg).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Logs in with the RS256 service-account JWT (session cookies) and returns user_code and username.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: BatchUpsertPricing for one partner SKU (listing_id) in the configured country_code: sets the price. Only `price` is applied — quantities go through set_inventory and titles/descriptions through the Content API (brand, category and attributes required). The per-item result is in result_code/message.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: BatchUpsertPricing with is_active false for the partner SKU (listing_id) in the configured country_code: deactivates the offer there.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: UpdateStock {items: [{warehouse_code, partner_sku, qty}]} for the configured warehouse_code; `sku` is the partner SKU. The per-item result is in result_code/message.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: ListFbpiOrders for the configured warehouse_code (Fulfilled By Partner orders, up to 50 per page), created after `since` when given; pass next_cursor back as `cursor` (the next_token query parameter). Item statuses (mp_status, integration_status) are under items. `status` is not applied.
